**Spices** are consumable items in *Fallout 76*.

A container of spices. It can be used in certain recipes or eaten by itself.

- Five in Helvetia.
 - Three at the Freyja's Haus restaurant.
 - One at the butcher's house, the building with a billiard table.
 - One at the Honey Haus, on the window.
- Three at Skullbone Vantage.
- Three in Bolton Greens.
- Two in the exterior of Blackwater Mine, at the cooking area.
- Two at Portside Pub.
- Two at The General's Steakhouse.
- Two in Watoga, one in Watoga Shopping Plaza and another in the Drumlin Diner.
- Two in Flatwoods, one in the restaurant and one on the outside cooking area.
- Two in Riverside Manor.
- Two at The Whitespring Golf Club.
- One at Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go.
- One at The Sludge Hole.
- One at Sons of Dane Compound.
- One at Mountainside Bed & Breakfast.
- One at Johnson's Acre.
- One at Hillfolk Hotdogs.
- One at The Rusty Pick.
- One at Old Danielson Cabin.
